description: This file defines the MissingTokenException class, which extends MismatchedTokenException. It represents an exception thrown when a token is missing during parsing in a PHP-based parser or compiler infrastructure.

classes.name: MissingTokenException
classes.description: An exception class indicating a missing token during parsing, with additional information about the inserted token.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with expected token, input, and inserted token information.

methods.name: getMissingType
methods.description: Returns the expected token type that was missing.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the exception, including details about inserted tokens and current token text.
